cta.stores: Dispo sur App Store & Google Play

_source.brand: The owner's macroBody identity (step 050, 2026-11-18): colours, fonts and logo from the macroBody app (docs/DESIGN.md, theme) and the owner's own Reels. Logo drawn in-repo after the app icon; logo.png is logo.svg at 512 px. Every template picks its own style: the 8-bit templates keep Sweetie 16 and Press Start 2P in motion/src/lib/palette.ts and font.ts.
_source.colors: brand = emerald accent (white text on it); macros = the app's per-macro colours; light = main surfaces (bg, white cards, ink text); dark = dark mode. Video overlays (ffmpeg ops) use dark.text on dark.bg.
_source.fonts: Family names plus 'files' (paths relative to this file). files[0] is the static Inter Tight Black TTF the ffmpeg ops (drawtext, captions) use: the local ffmpeg cannot read WOFF2. The WOFF2 files are the variable Inter / Inter Tight the motion templates load (motion/src/lib/font.ts). Licences in motion/ASSETS_LICENSES.md.
_source.cta: End-card call to action: never a price, never 'lien en bio' unless the owner asks.
_source.address: tu or vous per template family: default (brand films, paper) vous; humour and live-action tu.
_source.safe_zone: Pixel insets on a 1080x1920 Reel. Top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6% = Meta Ads Guide for Instagram Reels (https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/video/instagram-reels), rounded up. right_rail 120 px = width of the like/comment/share/audio button column (https://www.revid.ai/instagram-reels-safe-zone, practical buffer, not a Meta figure). Checked 2026-11-17.
